# ScaleSprite <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Sprites](Blitz3D-Sprites)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ScaleSprite:Void sprite:Int32, x_scale:Float32, y_scale:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sprite` | In | Int32 | required | The sprite. |
| `x_scale` | In | Float32 | required | Width factor. |
| `y_scale` | In | Float32 | required | Height factor. |

## Description

Changes the width and height of a sprite. A sprite starts as 2 by 2 units, so a scale of 1 keeps that size. Unlike [ScaleEntity](ScaleEntity) it is the only way to scale a sprite and it keeps the sprite facing the camera.
